statements.statement: Another large sum of unexpended FY26 school funds is expected to be turned back to the town, pending full closeout of the books.
This year's school budget is very tight, making it difficult for the school department to pay for the financial operations review out of its own funds.
Last year's budget process fell behind schedule largely because there was no free cash number available in time.

warnings.about: the cost of the FY26/FY27 school financial operations review
warnings.prediction: The financial operations review is expected to be a one-time cost, not a recurring annual request to the Finance Committee.
